newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Treasure shrs suspended from trade.
newsitem.headline: China Treasure shrs suspended from trade.

text.p: Trading in shares of China Treasure Telecom Holdings Ltd was suspended at the company's request on Friday morning pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
Shares of the cordless telephone designer and manufacturer closed steady at HK$0.28 on Thursday.
The company said earlier this week it was in preliminary talks over the possible disposal of its property investment in Sun City, Huiyang county, in China's Guangdong province.
But no binding agreement had been reached, it added.
